TK-LU02-LA01 | UNIT 2 LEARNING ACTIVITY

Post, pause, protect

Select each habit. The objective is not secrecy or isolation; it is deliberate sharing that supports ordinary personal, family and professional life.

Why this matters:

Protection without isolation

Professional, family and community connections matter. A good protective habit does not ask people to disappear from normal life; it helps them share ordinary information with the right audience, at the right time.

Summary: sharing can be deliberate

Before you post, send or answer, take a brief pause. Consider your audience, the timing, and whether the detail combines routine, location, family or work-related access information in a way that is more revealing than intended.

Practical takeaway: Share ordinary life deliberately. Keep real-time location, routine and protected work detail out of public or unnecessary channels.
